# LSR-2 bill of materials and cost (generated by scripts/bom.py)

Source: `bom/bom_lsr2.yaml`. Authors: Anatol EA5KAO, Diego EA5JEF, Pedro Roca Molina (BricoHams). Every price and every bought-part mass is **VERIFY** (generic values, local quotes). Fabricated masses are read from `build/lsr2_build_report.json` (finished solids); costs of both routes come from `calc/lsr2_materials.py`; the script checks the fabricated total within 1 % against reported volume x density. Goal: light and cheap: the default route of each part is the cheaper one (within 5 % the lighter).

## Totals (VERIFY)

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Fabricated parts (default routes) | 461 € / 10.05 kg |
| Bought parts, fasteners, electronics | 346 € / 11.65 kg (estimated masses) |
| PLA patterns and cores of the cast parts | 154 € (7.69 kg PLA, not in the mass) |
| **Total, one rotator without mast, antenna and cable run** | **960 €** |
| **Mass, rotator and electronics** | **21.69 kg** |

By group: Motion 146 €, Bearings 18 €, Cross boom 13 €, Lift arms and counterweights 15 €, Hardware 21 €, Fasteners 8 €, Corrosion 6 €, Electronics 94 €, Sensors 8 €, Wiring 17 €, fabricated 461 €, PLA 154 €.

The two NMRV030 gearboxes and the two NEMA23 motors dominate the mass and the cost of the bought parts; see [LSR2_MATERIALS](LSR2_MATERIALS.md) for the cost model and [LSR2_ASSEMBLY](LSR2_ASSEMBLY.md) for the build. Dimensioned drawings of every fabricated part (`LSR2_part_NN_*.svg|pdf`, BricoHams title block with material, tolerances and scale), the exploded view with the Pos balloons and the wiring diagram are in [drawings/](drawings/) (`make lsr2`); open items in [OPEN_ITEMS](OPEN_ITEMS.md).

## Budget build variant (not the default, not in the totals above)

SARCTrac Mk5 (SARCNET) builds the mast platform and boom saddle from galvanised angle brackets. This variant is NOT the default: it is not covered by calc/lsr2_sizing.py (no demonstrated clamp friction or boom bending path), galvanised steel next to the aluminium and stainless parts invites galvanic corrosion on the coast, and the steel is heavier than the cast parts it replaces. Prices VERIFY.

| Item | Qty | Unit € (VERIFY) | Total € | Replaces / consequence |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Galvanised angle bracket 50x50x5, 100 mm (mast platform, replaces mast_bracket) | 4 | 1.50 | 6.00 | mast_bracket: friction hold of the gearbox standstill torque not shown; use Tef-Gel/isolating washers against aluminium |
| Galvanised angle bracket 50x50x5, 100 mm + 2 U-bolts (boom, replaces saddle + boom clamps) | 4 | 1.50 | 6.00 | saddle and boom clamps: no bending path for the cross boom shown |
| Galvanised M8 hardware set (U-bolts, nuts, washers) | 1 | 4.00 | 4.00 | A4 M8 hardware: rusts within a season at the coast; mixed metals need Tef-Gel |
